'''M-5Q5''' was a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|shopkeeper droid]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war it was stationed in the Republic's secret [[Belsavis prison|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. In the prison it operated a stall in the [[Prison Command Center]] of the [[Minimum Security Section]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] had [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and golden plating.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
M-5Q5 first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in which it served as a Republic companion customisation vendor on Belsavis.<ref name="TOR" />
